evaluation.hypothesis: An in-call constraint and counterexample check may reduce valid wrong answers without extra model calls or tools.
evaluation.source: Twelve fresh implementer-authored procedural challenge objectives, three per domain, each answered once by both existing arms. No official GPQA/AIME questions or references used.
evaluation.oracleCrossCheck: All 24 old/new objectives cross-checked before live inference; challenge uses separate Python Fraction full-joint enumeration, truncated causal factorization, Burnside fixed-period DP and allowlisted actual Python generator semantics.
evaluation.cleanupBasis: Runner rejects before recording results unless each disposable repository close reports sourceUnchanged and cleanupVerified.

decision.rationale: Control 9/12 versus countercheck 8/12; provider-stable 12/12 pairs, compute-matched 9/12 pairs tie at 6/9 each. No measured net advantage supports promotion.
decision.nextRecommendation: Do not strengthen counterchecking merely by adding prompt text. Test a general exact-computation/state-tracking hypothesis on separate development tasks, then fresh frozen transfer tasks with matched simpler controls; use only independently authorized existing tools.
limitations: Single draw per arm on only twelve objectives; multiple-choice success can include guessing, and no statistical superiority is established.
Fresh procedural objectives, not a sealed independently authored benchmark; oracle methods differ but assumptions remain partially correlated.
Arm order alternates globally but is confounded with domain: BAYES/SYMMETRY control-first, CAUSAL/PROGRAM_STATE countercheck-first. Future replication should counterbalance within each domain.
Only nine pairs meet the predeclared per-pair 10% realized-compute tolerance; the matched subset is a diagnostic, not the full randomized population.
Closed-book question-file-read-only scope; exact counting and program-state failures do not establish failure of a separately tool-enabled engineering loop.
Raw private model reasoning was not retained; incorrect final choices do not reveal a precise internal failure mechanism.
Zero delivery failures in this finite run does not prove future provider stability or elimination of every historical timeout.
Earlier GPQA wrong choices remain unproven fixed; earlier saturated procedural scores are not directly comparable to these harder objectives.

directlyImplemented: Fresh generalization evaluation without answer-specific tuning
conflicts: No authority-policy conflict; domain/order confounding is an evaluation limitation, not silently superseded evidence.
